## Où j'en suis
The replay tooling on branch lior/replay-12-11 is merged (PR #233) and the real replay has run: 18,442,107 events written to events.replay.v3, 3,118 schema-v2 lines diverted to the rejects file. The aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 is still running (61% at 09:52 UTC, hours 00–14 done) and the incident stays open until the counts match. (source: ses-rp-2, kestrel-analytics/ingest#233, r2-04, r2-06, r2-07)

- [en-cours] Aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12, reading events.replay.v3, started 08:57 UTC (source: ses-rp-2, r2-06)
- [prochaine-étape] Wait for the backfill to reach 100%, compare ClickHouse events_v3 hour by hour (1% tolerance), then close the incident (source: r2-06, r2-08, r2-10)
- [essai-raté] Dry run with 50k batches was OOMKilled (exit 137, 2Gi limit), and the `kubectl wait` on replay-dryrun-1 failed; 5k batches work, peak 310 MiB (source: src-sentry-oom, ses-rp-1, r1-03, r1-05)
- [question] Rachel told Fernhill and Orbitly the data is back by Thursday, while Orbitly expected it Wednesday 18 Nov; the exact customer date still needs confirming (source: r2-07, src-zendesk-orbitly)
- [décision] Keep every event and replay into events.replay.v3; the tool must never produce to events.v3 directly (source: r1-02, src-slack-incident)
- [décision] Daniel owns the dedup-key CI check, Rachel owns customer comms, and no other fix goes into this incident — so the fork PR #241 is ignored (source: src-slack-incident, r2-09)
- [décision] PR #233 approved by Daniel and merged; the real replay runs with 5k batches and the namespace memory limit stays untouched (source: r2-01, kestrel-analytics/ingest#233, r1-04)
